pages.text: $(li)$(item)Structure incomplete: at least 3 full layers needed$(): the tower is shorter than 3 complete layers, so it does nothing at all. Check every layer against the JEI info page: fireproof bricks on the edges, reinforcements on the corners, a fireproof brick in the bottom centre.

$(li)$(item)No fuel: add Coal Coke Dust$(): crush coal coke and drop the dust in the top of the shaft or funnel it into the output.$(li)$(item)No flux: add Limesand$().$(li)$(item)No Blast Furnace Hatch in the walls for hot air$(): one wall brick must be a Blast Furnace Hatch.

$(li)$(item)The hatch holds no Hot Air$(): pipe hot air from a blast stove into that hatch.$(li)$(item)Output tank full: pump the result out$(): pump the molten metal and the slag out of the output; it needs room for 144 mB in each tank.
The fuel, flux and hot air lines only appear while ore is waiting inside, so an empty furnace looks calm.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
